parsed.title: Sensor routes decision rows to the fold, contradicting the router's decision route
parsed.detail: P6 records the SENSOR_SIGNALS.md emission as "plan-owned → the unit's planner …; any other open row → the fold". The SPEC's own route table (AC1) answers `decision` for a decision-required row, and S3 exists precisely to prevent "a human decision taken by an agent". A `decision`-class open row is "any other open row", so the emitted `next.suggested` sends it to `/fold-findings`, contradicting the router's `decision` route and S3's failure category. AC6 only pins replan/fix-now/none, so no validator catches this.
